set -eu

cat > /tmp/inventory-backup <<'ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_BACKUP'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

umask 077
source_parent=/srv/inventory
source_dir=$source_parent/data
backup_dir=/var/backups/inventory

if [ ! -d "$source_dir" ]; then
    printf 'inventory backup source is missing: %s\n' "$source_dir" >&2
    exit 1
fi

install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root "$backup_dir"
stamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%NZ)
archive=$backup_dir/inventory-$stamp.tar.gz
temporary=$(mktemp "$backup_dir/.inventory-backup.XXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    if [ -n "${temporary:-}" ]; then
        rm -f -- "$temporary"
    fi
}
trap cleanup 0 1 2 15

tar -C "$source_parent" -czf "$temporary" data
tar -tzf "$temporary" >/dev/null
chmod 0600 "$temporary"
mv -- "$temporary" "$archive"
temporary=
trap - 0 1 2 15

find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -printf '%f\n' \
    | LC_ALL=C sort -r \
    | awk 'NR > 7' \
    | while IFS= read -r obsolete; do
        rm -f -- "$backup_dir/$obsolete"
      done

printf 'created %s\n' "$archive"
ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_BACKUP
install -m 0750 -o root -g root /tmp/inventory-backup /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
rm -f /tmp/inventory-backup
restorecon -RF /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup /var/backups/inventory 2>/dev/null || true
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U:%G context=%C path=%n' /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup /var/backups/inventory
/usr/bin/sh -n /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup

[Unit]

ConditionPathIsDirectory=/srv/inventory/data
